    Changelog

    0.3.1 - 2026-08-04

    Changed

    • Updated the package version to 0.3.1.
    • UIViewVisibility now owns its Show and Hide UIAnimation settings directly.

    Removed

    • Breaking: removed the legacy UIViewId and UIAnimationPreset ScriptableObject types, their Create Asset menus, and UIViewVisibility.Preset.

    0.3.0 - 2026-08-03

    Added

    • Added the public Editor-only UINavigationGraphBuilder API for code-first .uinavgraph authoring.
    • Added AddPortal, PortalNode, and Connect(PortalNode, ScreenNode).
    • Added the Portal Condition inspector card matching the UI node inspector style.

    Changed

    • Kept Portal options in the Graph Inspector to reduce canvas node size.
    • Portal output labels now reflect their configured condition.

    0.2.0 - 2026-08-02

    • Added panel-local LIFO popups, NavElement startup settings, Category/Variant transitions, and scene/application Action nodes.
    • Standardized the UXML element names as NavElement, NavButton, and NavToggle.

    0.1.0 - 2026-07-28

    • Added Graph Toolkit .uinavgraph authoring, runtime import, Key Catalog, and UI Builder address pickers.
